content.comment_body: My [product_name] is only outputting a maximum of 16mA. How can I resolve this? Could the scaling be incorrect?

You didn’t specify what you are trying to achieve and the exact circuit details, so I can’t fully understand your setup or parameter configuration. One thing I can mention: the analog output only accepts up to 1000 units for its input signal. Any value beyond 1000 units will be ignored. For voltage output, this range represents 0-10V, and for current output, it covers 0/4-20mA, depending on your settings.
